digest.component_or_area: Claude Code transcript backfill adapter for metrics
key_entities: classification enum: env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none
propositions: An optional, isolated adapter mines local Claude Code session transcripts to reconstruct env/integration-diagnosis history not captured by structural signals.
The adapter performs a targeted error-signature grep over transcript JSONL then applies a deterministic keyword/regex classifier (no LLM or network call) mapping signatures to a classification enum.
Every emitted record is labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate it from authoritative structural series.
A portability guard ensures the core metrics package (registry.py and __init__.py) does not import the adapter, keeping the core command independent.
The backfill script is exercised end-to-end over a fixture transcript dir and must emit labeled classified records.
The classification enum and output JSON schema are defined in the adapter module, with tests asserting exact enum values and extraction behavior on fixture transcripts.
